title: The Bishop's Offer
text: A bishop of the Court offers absolution from a silk-hung chair, rings on every finger. Salvation has a price, he explains, and the price is a donation, and a name. Which House among you has sinned most? He already knows, he says. He only wants to hear you say it.

options.label: Name a rival House as the worst sinner.

outcomes.text: He writes it down in purple ink. The Court will look into it, he says, and smiles.
Absolved, every one of you, with a wave of a ringed hand. It feels better than it should.

options.label: The wisest names his sins instead.

outcomes.text: He goes white beneath his paint, and lets you go very quickly.
